findings.text: TRIPLANAR CROSSHATCH GONE. The habitat hull has no UVs -- export_gltf.py writes POSITION and NORMAL only -- so every material relies on world triplanar, which blends two grids across the drum's barrel. Replaced with a cylindrical mapping about the spin axis. The seam closes because the repeat count around the circumference is snapped to a whole number at a reference radius, and mip selection uses derivatives taken from the smooth tangent frame rather than from the discontinuous uv.

BAND TILING BROKEN UP. 28% of blocks, five repeats square, have no lit windows -- a section with no quarters behind it. Clearly visible in the anti-sun frame as unlit segments along the barrel. Sized in repeats so a block boundary never cuts a window in half.
